name: everything
description: Official reference server from the MCP steering group demonstrating every protocol feature: tools, resources, prompts, and sampling. Use it to test MCP clients and learn the protocol surface.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.everything: {command: "cmd", args: ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-everything"]} (Windows npx wrapper)
hermes mcp add everything --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-everything
No API keys required
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: fetch
description: Official Python reference server that fetches URLs and converts web content (HTML to Markdown, JSON, etc.) for efficient LLM consumption. Handles redirects, robots.txt, and content-size limits.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.fetch: {command: "uvx", args: ["mcp-server-fetch"]}
hermes mcp add fetch --command uvx --args mcp-server-fetch
No API keys required (respects robots.txt)
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: filesystem
description: Official reference server providing secure file operations (read, write, search, list) restricted to a configured allowlist of directories. Uses MCP Roots for access control.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.filesystem: {command: "cmd", args: ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem", "C:/path/to/allowed"]} (Windows npx wrapper)
hermes mcp add filesystem --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem <allowed-dir>
No API keys; pass allowed directory as final arg
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: git
description: Official Python reference server exposing git operations as MCP tools: status, log, diff, blame, commit, branch management, and more. Point it at a repository path to give agents native git powers.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.git: {command: "uvx", args: ["mcp-server-git", "--repository", "C:/path/to/repo"]}
hermes mcp add git --command uvx --args mcp-server-git --repository <repo-path>
No API keys required
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: memory
description: Official reference server implementing a persistent knowledge graph memory with entities, relations, and observations. Gives assistants long-term memory across sessions.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.memory: {command: "cmd", args: ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-memory"]} (Windows npx wrapper)
hermes mcp add memory --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-memory
No API keys required (memory persists to local file)
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: sequentialthinking
description: Official reference server implementing dynamic, reflective problem-solving through sequential thought chains. Lets models break problems into verifiable steps and backtrack when needed.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.sequentialthinking: {command: "cmd", args: ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking"]} (Windows npx wrapper)
hermes mcp add sequentialthinking --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-sequential-thinking
No API keys required
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: time
description: Official Python reference server providing current time and timezone conversion tools. Useful for any agent that must reason about schedules, deadlines, or timestamps across zones.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.time: {command: "uvx", args: ["mcp-server-time"]}
hermes mcp add time --command uvx --args mcp-server-time
No API keys required
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: github (archived reference)
description: Archived official reference server for GitHub: repo management, issue/PR operations, and file access via the GitHub API. Superseded by the official github/github-mcp-server (docker) — prefer that for production.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.github: {command: "cmd", args: ["/c", "npx", "-y", "@modelcontextprotocol/server-github"], env: {GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN: "<token>"}}
hermes mcp add github --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github
Env: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (classic PAT with repo scope)
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: postgres (archived reference)
description: Archived official reference server providing read-only access to PostgreSQL databases with schema inspection. Pass a connection string to query, list tables, and inspect schemas safely.

hermes mcp add postgres --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-postgres <connection-string>
No extra env; credentials go in the connection-string arg
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: sqlite (archived reference)
description: Archived official reference server for SQLite databases: run queries, inspect tables, and do business-intelligence analysis. Simple, file-based, zero-config database MCP.
connect_steps: config.yaml: mcp_servers.sqlite: {command: "uvx", args: ["mcp-server-sqlite", "--db-path", "C:/path/to/db.sqlite"]}
hermes mcp add sqlite --command uvx --args mcp-server-sqlite --db-path <db-file>
No API keys; choose the .db file path
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify

name: brave-search (archived reference)

hermes mcp add brave-search --command npx --args -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-brave-search
Env: BRAVE_API_KEY (free tier from brave.com/search/api)

No API keys; downloads Chromium on first run

name: slack (archived reference)

name: github-mcp-server
description: GitHub's official production MCP server (Go binary in docker) covering the full GitHub REST API: repos, issues, PRs, actions, search. The recommended GitHub integration going forward.

hermes mcp add github --command docker --args run -i --rm -e GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN ghcr.io/github/github-mcp-server
Env: GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN (fine-grained or classic PAT)
Restart Hermes and run hermes mcp list to verify (Docker Desktop must be running)

hermes mcp add playwright --command npx --args -y @playwright/mcp@latest

Env: AIVEN_TOKEN (API token from Aiven console; free trial available)
